findings.summary: Work-toggle button styling is duplicated across library result components.
findings.consequence: The browse work disclosure and source-download work control must keep reset, truncation, color, pointer, hover, and focus-visible behavior synchronized manually; future accessibility or visual fixes can drift between the two implementations.
findings.evidence: The owned `.library-work-toggle` block at lines 249-262 and hover/focus-visible block at lines 264-267 match the same selector and declarations in `app/components/library/LibrarySourceDownloadWorkspace.vue` lines 575-593. Both components apply `data-library-work-toggle` to title buttons with the same visual and keyboard-focus expectations.
findings.recommendation: Move the shared `.library-work-toggle` reset, ellipsis, default color, and hover/focus-visible color rules into a common library stylesheet or established utility class, leaving component-scoped CSS only for behavior unique to each result renderer.
